```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
genome_counts_filt %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-genome),~./sum(.)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-genome, names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>% 
  left_join(., genome_metadata, by = join_by(genome == genome)) %>% 
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x=sample,y=count, fill=phylum, group=phylum)) + 
    geom_bar(stat="identity", colour="white", linewidth=0.1) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=phylum_colors) +
    facet_nested(. ~ factor (experiment_phase, levels=c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3", "TEMP-1", "ABX-1", "ABX-2","ABX-3","ABX-4","ABX-5","POST-ABX","FMT-1", "FMT-2", "FMT-3", "POST-1", "POST-2", "POST-3", "POST-4")) + experimental_group , scales = "free") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
    theme(
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.6),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black")) +
   labs(fill="Phylum",y = "Relative abundance",x="samples")
```

Differences between PRE- treatment and POST-1 (first week) after FMT, across the treatment groups
```{r}
# Richness
alpha_div_meta <- alpha_div %>%pivot_longer(cols = -sample,names_to = "metric",values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata,by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3", "POST-1"),
         metric == "richness") %>%
  mutate(combined_phase = if_else(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3"),"PRE","POST-1"),
    combined_phase = factor(combined_phase,levels = c("PRE", "POST-1")),
    experimental_group = factor(experimental_group))
```
```{r}
Modelq0LMM <- lmer(value ~ experimental_group*combined_phase+(1|animal_ID), data = alpha_div_meta)
summary(Modelq0LMM)
```
```{r}
emmeans(
  Modelq0LMM,
  pairwise ~ experimental_group | combined_phase,
  adjust = "BH"
)
```

```{r}
#Plotting
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample,names_to = "metric",values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter((experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3", "POST-1"))) %>%
  mutate(combined_phase = if_else(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3"),"PRE","POST-1"),
    combined_phase = factor(combined_phase,levels = c("PRE", "POST-1")),
    metric = factor(
      metric,levels = c("richness", "neutral", "phylogenetic"),
      labels = c("Richness", "Neutral", "Phylogenetic")),
    experimental_group = factor(experimental_group, levels = c("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = combined_phase,
    y = value,
    fill = experimental_group,
    color = experimental_group
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.15),
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    metric ~ experimental_group,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Experiment phase",
    y = "Alpha diversity",
    color = "Experimental group",
    fill = "Experimental group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

Beta div across experimenal-groups, in the first week post-FMT
```{r}
samples_beta_FMT <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("POST-1")) %>%
  select(EHI_number) %>% 
  pull()

sample_metadata_beta_FMT <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("POST-1"))

length(samples_beta_FMT)
```
```{r}
# Richness
beta_q0n_mat <- as.matrix(beta_q0n$q0S)
beta_q0n_filtered_FMT <- beta_q0n_mat[
  rownames(beta_q0n_mat) %in% sample_metadata_beta_FMT$EHI_number,
  colnames(beta_q0n_mat) %in% sample_metadata_beta_FMT$EHI_number
]
beta_q0n_dis <- as.dist(beta_q0n_filtered_FMT)

sample_metadata_beta_FMT_ordered <- sample_metadata_beta_FMT %>%
  filter(EHI_number %in% labels(beta_q0n_dis)) %>%
  arrange(match(EHI_number, labels(beta_q0n_dis))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "EHI_number")

betadisper(beta_q0n_dis, sample_metadata_beta_FMT_ordered$experimental_group) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE) 
```
```{r}
adonis2(beta_q0n_dis ~ experimental_group,
        data = sample_metadata_beta_FMT %>% arrange(match(EHI_number,labels(beta_q0n_dis))),
        permutations = 999) %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```

```{r}
# All six pairwise comparisons
group_pairs <- combn(c("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4"), 2,
                     simplify = FALSE)

pairwise_permanova <- map_dfr(group_pairs, function(pair) {

  # Select samples from the two groups
  keep <- sample_metadata_beta_FMT$experimental_group %in% pair
  meta_sub <- droplevels(sample_metadata_beta_FMT[keep, ])

  # Subset the distance matrix in matching order
  samples_sub <- meta_sub$EHI_number
  dist_sub <- as.dist(
    as.matrix(beta_q1n_dis)[samples_sub, samples_sub, drop = FALSE]
  )

  # Run PERMANOVA
  set.seed(123)
  result <- adonis2(
    dist_sub ~ experimental_group,
    data = meta_sub,
    permutations = 999
  )

  tibble(
    group_1 = pair[1],
    group_2 = pair[2],
    F_value = result$F[1],
    R2 = result$R2[1],
    p_value = result$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
})

pairwise_permanova <- pairwise_permanova %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adjusted_BH < 0.05
  )

pairwise_permanova
```
```{r}
#Plotting
beta_q1n_dis %>%
                metaMDS(.,trymax = 500, k=2, verbosity=FALSE, trace=FALSE) %>%
                vegan::scores() %>%
                as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
                left_join(sample_metadata_beta_FMT, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
            group_by(experimental_group) %>%
            mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            ggplot(., aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2, color=experimental_group)) +
                geom_point(size=2) +
                geom_segment(aes(x=x_cen, y=y_cen, xend=NMDS1, yend=NMDS2), alpha=0.2) +
        labs(y = "NMDS2", x="NMDS1 \n Neutral beta diversity") +
```
```{r}
                theme_classic() +
                theme(legend.position="none")
```

Now, comparing 1 PRE- v. the remaining weeks post FMT (POST-2-4)
```{r}
# Richness
alpha_div_meta <- alpha_div %>%pivot_longer(cols = -sample,names_to = "metric",values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata,by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3", "POST-1", "POST-2", "POST-3", "POST-4"),
         metric == "richness") %>%
  mutate(
    combined_phase = case_when(
      experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3") ~ "PRE",
      experiment_phase == "POST-1" ~ "POST-1",
      experiment_phase == "POST-2" ~ "POST-2", 
      experiment_phase == "POST-3" ~ "POST-3",
      experiment_phase == "POST-4" ~ "POST-4"
    ),
    combined_phase = factor(
      combined_phase,
      levels = c("PRE", "POST-1", "POST-2", "POST-3", "POST-4")
    ),
    experimental_group = factor(experimental_group)
  )
```
```{r}
Modelq0LMM <- lmer(value ~ experimental_group*combined_phase+(1|animal_ID), data = alpha_div_meta)
summary(Modelq0LMM)
```
```{r}
emmeans(
  Modelq0LMM,
  pairwise ~ experimental_group | combined_phase,
  adjust = "BH"
)
```

```{r}
        data = sample_metadata_beta_FMT %>% arrange(match(EHI_number,labels(beta_q1n_dis))),
        permutations = 999) %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```
```{r}
# All six pairwise comparisons
group_pairs <- combn(c("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4"), 2,
                     simplify = FALSE)

pairwise_permanova <- map_dfr(group_pairs, function(pair) {

  # Select samples from the two groups
  keep <- sample_metadata_beta_FMT$experimental_group %in% pair
  meta_sub <- droplevels(sample_metadata_beta_FMT[keep, ])

  # Subset the distance matrix in matching order
  samples_sub <- meta_sub$EHI_number
  dist_sub <- as.dist(
    as.matrix(beta_q1n_dis)[samples_sub, samples_sub, drop = FALSE]
  )

  # Run PERMANOVA
  set.seed(123)
  result <- adonis2(
    dist_sub ~ experimental_group,
    data = meta_sub,
    permutations = 999
  )

  tibble(
    group_1 = pair[1],
    group_2 = pair[2],
    F_value = result$F[1],
    R2 = result$R2[1],
    p_value = result$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
})

pairwise_permanova <- pairwise_permanova %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adjusted_BH < 0.05
  )

pairwise_permanova
```

```{r}
#Plotting
beta_q1n_dis %>%
                metaMDS(.,trymax = 500, k=2, verbosity=FALSE, trace=FALSE) %>%
                vegan::scores() %>%
                as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
                left_join(sample_metadata_beta_FMT, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
            group_by(experimental_group) %>%
            mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            ggplot(., aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2, color=experimental_group)) +
                geom_point(size=2) +
                geom_segment(aes(x=x_cen, y=y_cen, xend=NMDS1, yend=NMDS2), alpha=0.2) +
        labs(y = "NMDS2", x="NMDS1 \n Neutral beta diversity") +
                theme_classic() +
                theme(legend.position="none")
```
